def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive extraction of position and game info
    position = observation.get('position', (0, 0))
    x, y = position
    
    # Initialize move to stay in place
    dx, dy = 0, 0
    
    # Attempt to get opponent position, fallback to no movement
    opponent_pos = observation.get('opponent_position', None)
    if opponent_pos:
        opp_x, opp_y = opponent_pos
        # Move towards opponent
        if opp_x > x:
            dx = 1
        elif opp_x < x:
            dx = -1
        # If aligned, consider vertical movement
        elif opp_y > y:
            dy = 1
        elif opp_y < y:
            dy = -1
    
    # Check resource positions if available
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    if resources:
        # Move towards the nearest resource
        min_dist = float('inf')
        target = None
        for res in resources:
            dx_res = res[0] - x
            dy_res = res[1] - y
            dist = abs(dx_res) + abs(dy_res)
            if dist < min_dist:
                min_dist = dist
                target = res
        if target:
            dx_target = target[0] - x
            dy_target = target[1] - y
            # Choose direction to reduce distance
            if abs(dx_target) > abs(dy_target):
                dx = 1 if dx_target > 0 else -1 if dx_target < 0 else 0
                dy = 0
            else:
                dy = 1 if dy_target > 0 else -1 if dy_target < 0 else 0
    
    # Territory control concerns (e.g., aim to stay within a radius)
    territory_center = observation.get('territory_center', None)
    if territory_center:
        cx, cy = territory_center
        dx_territory = cx - x
        dy_territory = cy - y
        # Move towards territory center if outside a threshold
        threshold = 2
        if abs(dx_territory) > threshold:
            dx = 1 if dx_territory > 0 else -1
        elif abs(dy_territory) > threshold:
            dy = 1 if dy_territory > 0 else -1
    
    # Final move decision (prioritized: resources > opponent pursuit > territory positioning)
    # The above code naturally prioritizes resource seeking; opponent pursuit and territory adjustments follow
    return [dx, dy]
